snippet.title: NBA BOUNCE – Gameplay Reveal Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
NBA BOUNCE is launching for Nintendo Switch on Sep 26, 2025!

Welcome to NBA BOUNCE, a family-friendly basketball game where little ballers get to shine on the court! Whether you're dribbling solo or teaming up with up to 4 players locally, NBA BOUNCE brings fast-paced 3v3 basketball action with easy-to-learn controls and tons of fun. 

Experience thrilling gameplay packed with: 

• Exciting practice and party modes 
• Custom MVP looks and unlockable gear 
• Official NBA teams and mascots 
• Hype commentators calling clutch plays 

Ready to step onto the court and chase highlight worthy moments? Whether you’re a rookie or a pro, NBA BOUNCE makes basketball accessible, fun, and full of energy for players of all ages. 

#NBABOUNCE #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
